title: The approximate tangent plane field of an integer multiplicity triple is measurable
statement: Let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (IMRep univ n) with weight μ = θH^n⌞M (R.measure). For x ∈ ℝ^P let T_x = approxTangentPlane n M x (the approximate tangent n-plane of M at x where it exists, {0} otherwise) and p_x the orthogonal projection onto T_x. Then x ↦ p_x is μ-a.e. measurable as a map ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) (Borel σ-algebra).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), AEMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure
